0022600128.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-2, on a two-game losing streak and 12th in the East) visit the Boston Celtics (1-1, 7th in the East) for the Nets' fourth game of the 2026-27 season. Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain) are out for Brooklyn, and Devin Carter (illness) is out for Boston. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost the season series 1-3, including a 148-111 loss in Boston on February 27, 2026.
